tasks.short: Draw conceptual land development and growth over time

steps.what: Read the actual site plan and define defensible growth/development stages and visual assumptions
inputs: actual site survey/design and planting or development intentions
actual species/site constraints and intended time horizons
outputs: architect-defined stage assumptions and site references

steps.what: Prepare conceptual drawings, graphics and visual representations showing predicted land-area growth or development over time
inputs: architect-defined stage assumptions and site references
actual design geometry and selected visual symbols

steps.what: Check and finish the staged graphics against actual geometry, growth assumptions, uncertainty labels and visual clarity
inputs: architect-defined stage assumptions and site references

steps.what: Save the completed checked staged conceptual graphics in the existing design workspace

tasks.design: Configure native phase layers, linked geometry and reusable drawing symbols in {OTHER}, the landscape CAD/visualisation software. The architect supplies the actual time-stage assumptions, creates and checks the staged graphics, then saves the final version; the configuration does not predict biological growth.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying and formatting of stage geometry can consume drafting effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked layers and reusable symbols can carry checked geometry across conceptual stages.
tasks.still_hard: Future growth depends on maintenance, climate, species and actual development decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Make uncertainty visible instead of presenting a conceptual stage as a forecast guarantee.

ambition.what: No forecast accuracy or additional design throughput claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native phase layers and linked drawing geometry can reduce repeated drafting while growth assumptions and visual review remain architect-led.

assumptions: Shares are provisional drafting effort, not measured baselines or the prompt prior.

Surveyors/designers provide actual site geometry; the landscape architect supplies time-stage and planting assumptions in s1. Missing growth evidence remains an explicit uncertainty, not a generated fact.
Only repeated drawing handling changes; existing equivalent CAD features remove the gain. Rendering runtime already belongs to today's tools.
Gross provisional saving 9 minus 1.5 hours of layer/symbol upkeep gives 7.5 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
The final graphic version is checked in s3; any edit requires checking again before its save. No client send is assumed.
unknowns: Current use of linked phases and repeated geometry
research_questions: How much real stage drafting repeats geometry after existing CAD features are credited?

already_counted.description: Inspect drafted stages and finish/check final graphics

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 7.5%; growth assumptions and complete graphic review remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify actual sustainable material candidates and inspect technical, environmental and application evidence
inputs: actual landscape application and performance requirements
actual supplier specifications and environmental evidence

steps.what: Compare candidate sustainable materials and select appropriate products for the actual landscape design
inputs: actual structural, exposure, maintenance and user constraints

steps.what: Enter and check the selected material identity, application and supporting references in the actual design specification
Save the completed checked sustainable-material specification entry

tasks.design: Configure native source/version links in {PROCUREMENT} and {DOCS}, with fixed material-reference fields in {OTHER}, the landscape specification/CAD application. The architect reads actual evidence, selects for the real application and checks the actual specification entry before saving; recycled content is not treated as proof of suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and specification-reference entry can interrupt material selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native product references can reuse actual supplier identity and document versions.
tasks.still_hard: Environmental claims, durability and application safety require critical assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Reject a superficially sustainable product that fails the actual site use.

ambition.what: No automatic purchasing or sustainability certification.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for supplier and design specification access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native material-source links can reduce navigation and reference entry while suitability selection remains a professional judgment.

assumptions: Shares describe unmeasured selection with its actual design-specification entry, not a separate invented sustainability report.
Suppliers supply actual specifications/environmental claims; the architect verifies relevance in s1 and supplies application constraints in s2. Missing test evidence requires manual investigation.
No new structured environmental database or automatic claim interpretation is assumed. Existing equivalent source fields remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 4.95 minus 1 hour of source-field upkeep gives 3.95 net. Same-system save is negligible and fully retained.
unknowns: Actual product evidence completeness and current source links
research_questions: Do actual selections repeat source navigation or specification references beyond current native tools?

already_counted.description: Inspect candidate evidence and check the specification entry

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.95%; all material suitability assessment remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research products, technologies and landscape design trends

steps.what: Search actual product, technology and landscape-design publications and choose relevant current sources
inputs: actual publisher/vendor source pages with dates

steps.what: Read and compare relevant product, technology or trend claims and draft working research notes

loop.purpose: Propose a source-linked comparison of unfamiliar product/technology claims
loop.input: selected actual source text and architect's question
loop.output: draft comparison with source passages and explicit evidence gaps
loop.check: Architect opens every material claim's cited passage and checks relevance, date and vendor bias
loop.stop: Missing source passage, conflicting version or unsupported claim returns to manual reading
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed metadata filters cannot compare the meaning and limits of diverse technical claims

steps.what: Evaluate applicability, verify substantive claims against original sources and complete actual research notes
outputs: complete checked research notes with uncertainty and references

steps.what: Save the completed checked research notes in the existing reference workspace
inputs: complete checked research notes with uncertainty and references

tasks.design: Use native saved searches in {OTHER}, the browser/reference manager, before adding a bounded source-comparison draft in {DOCS}. The architect supplies actual selected text, verifies the proposed comparison against original passages and completes notes before saving; no uncited trend claims or automated publication are allowed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diverse technical descriptions take effort to compare even after search filters.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded language-model comparison can propose a reading aid from actual selected passages.
tasks.still_hard: Vendor claims and fashionable designs may not transfer to a particular landscape application.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether an apparent innovation has adequate evidence for practice.

ambition.what: No automatic design recommendation or verified market coverage claim.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for permitted source text and model processing access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded source comparison can assist technical reading, but source validity and applicability still require professional verification.

assumptions: Shares are an unmeasured research session that actually uses working notes. No measured reading speed is claimed.
Publishers/vendors produce actual source text and dates; the architect selects and captures permitted text in s1. Inaccessible sources are read manually; no hidden corpus ingestion is free.
Native filters address discovery first. The loop only compares source meanings and cannot invent missing specifications, quotations or URLs.
Claim verification is retained in s2/s3. Gross provisional saving 11.5 minus 2 hours of source/prompt upkeep gives 9.5 net; the final save earns no gain.
unknowns: Comparison accuracy and net reading effort with verification
research_questions: Do source-linked comparisons reduce actual research effort after verification and source capture?

already_counted.description: Inspect proposed comparisons and verify original claims

incremental.description: Maintain source processing rules and inspect comparison failures

approvals.approved_version: complete checked research notes with uncertainty and references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 9.5%; source capture and full substantive verification remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design rainwater, gray-water and reclaimed-water conservation systems

steps.what: Read actual catchment, water demand, site levels and water-quality constraints for rainwater or gray/reclaimed-water use
inputs: actual survey, catchment and demand information
outputs: architect-checked water-system design inputs and gaps

steps.what: Design the water balance, storage, treatment and routing arrangement appropriate to the intended conservation use
inputs: architect-checked water-system design inputs and gaps
actual design criteria and selected assumptions

steps.what: Integrate the selected rainwater harvesting or gray/reclaimed-water system into actual building/land design drawings
Check and finish system interfaces, levels, separation, access and design assumptions against the actual site/building design
inputs: architect-checked water-system design inputs and gaps

steps.what: Save the completed checked integrated water-conservation design

tasks.design: Configure native linked components/layers in {OTHER}, the landscape/building CAD application, for the architect's chosen water-system arrangement. Existing {SPREADSHEET} water-balance calculations stay credited to today's work; the architect designs and checks actual interfaces before saving the integrated design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated component placement and layer handling can interrupt integration of a selected system.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked components can reuse checked design geometry without choosing water-system suitability.
tasks.still_hard: Actual demand, water quality, overflow paths and interfaces require project-specific engineering.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an unsuitable reuse route despite a plausible water balance.

ambition.what: No automatic water-quality approval or design release.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for site/building model access and responsible designer consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native linked CAD components can reduce repeated drafting while water-system design and interface validation remain professional work.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human design effort, not measured water-system baselines.
Survey/design owners supply actual geometry; project owners supply demand/use constraints; the architect investigates gaps in s1 and supplies selected sizing/routing assumptions in s2.
No new structured hydrological feed is assumed. Existing computation and equivalent component reuse remove corresponding gains; all sizing and quality decisions remain retained.
Gross provisional saving 2.5 minus 0.75 hour of component upkeep gives 1.75 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
This ends with a checked design; actual permit submissions, specialist approvals and construction orders are separate responsibilities, not automated here.
unknowns: Current component reuse and specialist interface requirements
research_questions: Is repeated CAD placement still significant after current native design tools are credited?

already_counted.description: Inspect integrated geometry and check actual system interfaces

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.75%; all site-specific design and interface review remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Validate phase assumptions and integrated CAD geometry
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated drafting and source comparison while retaining accountable landscape and water-system design.
